ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels (>98%) with high-intensity white pixels localized exclusively at the distal tips, resulting in a low global contrast ratio across the primary surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark grey to black pixel distribution across the main lobe bodies. Two distinct high-contrast white circular clusters (barnacle sites) are mapped to the extreme lateral margins of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated internal angle of approximately 82 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing boundary. Individual peaks show pixel amplitudes between 10 and 25 units relative to the adjacent valleys, creating a jagged, non-linear edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong upward convex curvature originating from the median notch and sweeping towards the dorsally-oriented distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of high-contrast white pixels at the tip of the left lobe (approx. 5-7 distinct spots) and the tip of the right lobe (approx. 3-4 distinct spots).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized white scarring and barnacle colonization at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of dark pigmentation (Type 5 classification) covering nearly 100% of the visible ventral surface, excluding small distal apex regions.
